description:
Port pi-ai's partial-JSON parsing (utils/json-parse.ts + `partial-json` npm lib). Input: a potentially incomplete JSON string arriving as deltas. Output: best-effort parsed map, re-parsed on each delta.

Elixir's binary pattern matching makes this cleaner than the TS version. Unit tests with incrementally-built JSON fixtures from real Anthropic tool-call streams.
title: Streaming JSON parser for tool-call arguments
